name: Jaded Media
summary: The website for my own photography and film business. It opens with one line, “Photo and film, let's make art.”, and puts the work first. Behind the public pages sits an admin area for managing content and video.
highlights: Videos upload straight from the browser to Cloudflare R2 through short-lived signed URLs, so large files never pass through the app server.

Security was audited in a dedicated pass: a nonce-based Content Security Policy, HSTS, clickjacking protection, a locked-down Permissions-Policy, link-scheme checks on rendered markdown, and an hourly cap on admin email sending.
Legal, privacy, cookie-consent and accessibility work was done as its own phase and documented.
Runs on a custom domain, with a preview deployment for every branch before anything reaches production.

items: Next.js App Router and TypeScript
Admin dashboard with protected routes
Supabase backend for site data
Direct-to-storage video uploads with signed URLs
Content-type allowlists on uploads
Image and video delivery from Cloudflare R2
Content Security Policy with per-request nonces
Password-reset redirect hardening
Rate limiting on sensitive admin actions
Security audit with documented fixes
Privacy policy and consent flow
Accessibility review
Vercel deployments and custom domains
Phase-by-phase written documentation

name: Edgeline Exports
summary: A site for an online-only dealership that buys, sells and sources performance and luxury vehicles across Canada and the United States. Visitors browse inventory, ask for a specific car to be found, or offer their own for sale.
highlights: Three customer paths, each with its own page and form: buy from inventory, have a car sourced, or sell to the dealership.
The whole site switches between English and French and between light and dark themes.
Search and sharing are covered: structured data for the business, a generated share image, a sitemap, and a robots file that keeps the admin and API routes out of search.
A separate admin login for the owner, with loading states and a friendly 404 for sold or missing listings.

Tailwind CSS design system with custom brand tokens
Responsive layouts from phone to desktop
English and French content with a language toggle
Light and dark themes
Clear paths for buying, sourcing and selling
Loading and not-found states
Organization structured data (JSON-LD)

Sitemap and robots rules

name: This portfolio
kind: Personal portfolio with an admin backend
summary: The site you're on. It shows my other work in live, scrollable previews, lists my certifications with links to the official records, and has a private admin page where I add new certifications without touching code.
highlights: The previews are the real sites loaded in scaled frames, with a desktop and mobile toggle, so a visitor sees the actual work instead of screenshots.
Certifications are managed from a password-protected admin page that supports file upload, editing and deletion, and every entry links to the issuer's official record or the uploaded certificate.
The backend checks everything it receives: uploads are identified by their contents, links must be https, and admin actions need a signed session cookie plus a request header.
More than twenty automated tests and an end-to-end browser run cover login, uploads, validation, public pages and the security checks.
